mapper.sql: id, fact_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, parent_economics_id, order_id, order_context_id, context_format, payment_fact_id, client_price_id, settlement_business_days, business_calendar_code, settlement_timezone, cutoff_second_of_day, commercial_context_time, tax_snapshot_id, payment_intent_id, payment_attempt_id, payment_succeeded_time, balance_available_time, refund_request_id, channel_refund_id, duplicate_capture_item_id, channel_dispute_notice_id, dispute_case_id, client_id, entity_no, local_partner_id, consumer_country_code, payment_method, industry_code, mcc_code, client_agreement_id, partner_agreement_oe_id, finance_entity_id, currency, gross_amount, supersedes_fact_id, status, fact_version, channel_account_id, maker_id, checker_id, approved_time, published_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_economic_fact WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND source_event_key = #{sourceEventKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_economic_fact (id, fact_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, parent_economics_id, client_id, entity_no, local_partner_id, partner_agreement_oe_id, finance_entity_id, currency, gross_amount, supersedes_fact_id, status, fact_version, channel_account_id, maker_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{factType}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceEventKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{sourcePayloadHash}, #{parentEconomicsId}, #{clientId}, #{entityNo}, #{localPartnerId}, #{partnerAgreementOeId}, #{financeEntityId}, #{currency}, #{grossAmount}, #{supersedesFactId}, #{status}, #{factVersion}, #{channelAccountId}, #{makerId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_economic_fact SET status = 'APPROVED', fact_version = #{factVersion}, checker_id = #{checkerId}, approved_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, MAX(CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN id END) AS max_pending_fact_id, MAX(CASE WHEN published_at IS NOT NULL THEN id END) AS max_published_fact_id FROM t_economic_fact WHERE AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED')
